events.name: Bash
events.head: Run leak check and board sync, then check the public mirror for the feedback panel
events.input: $ python3 workshop-plan/tasks/sync_board.py --check 2>&1 | tail -4 | cut -c1-300; python3 workshop-plan/tasks/sync_board.py 2>&1 | tail -3 | cut -c1-300; sleep 1; curl -s "https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/tasks.html?v=$(date +%s)" | grep -c 'fb-count\|fb-form\|fb-open'; curl -s "https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/tasks/sync.json?v=$(date +%s)" | cut -c1-300; grep -n "fb-form\|api/inbox\|static" workshop-plan/tasks.html | grep -n "fb\|Feedback" | head -12 | cut -c1-260
